item.title: [Global][Backup as a Service] - Veeam Backup Managed maintenance notification
item.description:
THIS IS A SCHEDULED EVENT Jan 20, 2027, 08:00 - 18:00 UTC

Nov 17, 20:47 UTC
Scheduled - As part of our continuous improvement plan, maintenance is scheduled on our Veeam Backup Managed offer.

Start time : 20/01/2027 08:00 UTC
End time : 20/01/2027 18:00 UTC
Service impact : During the maintenance, the storage servers hosting your backup data will be updated. Your backup data will be temporarily unavailable during the update of each storage server, for approximately 50 minutes. Backup and restore jobs may be impacted during this period.
Service improvement : As part of our continuous improvement policy, we are updating the storage servers hosting your backup data. This brings improvements to certain mechanisms, as well as some performance enhancements.

Thank you for your understanding.

item.description:

Resolved - We are pleased to inform you that the incident affecting our Public VMware Cloud Foundation offering has been resolved.

Start time : 17/11/2026 01:00 UTC
End time : 20/11/2026 20:09 UTC
Root Cause : This incident was caused by a network equipment issue.

We apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your understanding.

Nov 20, 20:17 UTC
Update - We have new information regarding the incident that affects your service(s).

Nov 18, 11:00 UTC
Investigating - We are currently experiencing an ongoing incident. We have determined the origin of the issue affecting our Public VMware Cloud Foundation offer on the specific RBX region.

Here are some supplementary details :

Start time : 17/11/2026 01:00 UTC
Impacted Service(s) : High latency and packet loss on vRack network.
Customers Impact : Some customers may experience high latency and packet loss on the vRack network.
Ongoing Actions : Our teams are investigating to determine the origin of the incident and fix it.

We will keep you updated on the progress and resolution.

We apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your understanding.
